name: Loft Factory
tagline: Steel and solid-wood furniture for homes, cafés and offices
niche: Loft-style furniture: tables, chairs, shelving, furniture for cafés and offices

listing.description: A site for a loft-style furniture maker, a metalwork shop or a café furniture store. A dark workshop look, a table blueprint that draws itself on the first screen, a catalogue of steel plates and a welding seam for the work stages.

seo.title: Loft Factory — loft-style furniture in Tashkent
seo.description: Made-to-order tables, chairs, shelving and bar counters in steel and solid oak. Our own workshop in Sergeli, made in 14 days or more, delivery and assembly across Tashkent.
seo.answer: Loft Factory is a loft-style furniture workshop at 22 Yangi Sergeli St in Tashkent. We weld steel frames and make tops from solid oak and elm: a dining table from 6,900,000 UZS, a bar stool from 1,150,000 UZS, shelving from 3,400,000 UZS. Made in 14 days or more, 2-year warranty, delivery and assembly across Tashkent. Open Mon–Sat, 9:00–19:00.

sections.title: Furniture of steel and wood
sections.subtitle: Loft-style tables, chairs, shelving and bar counters for homes, cafés and offices. We weld the frames ourselves and make tops from solid oak and elm. Made in 14 days or more.

sections.label: The workshop
sections.title: Here furniture is welded, not assembled from a box
sections.text: We run our own workshop in Sergeli: welding bays, a paint booth and a joinery section. The frame, made of 40×40 mm box section, is fully welded and powder-coated, and the top is 40 mm solid oak or elm finished with oil. That is why a table does not wobble a year later and a chair survives a café from morning to night.

items.title: Measuring and sketch
items.text: We come over, take measurements and draw a sketch with frame options.

items.title: Quote and contract
items.text: The price is fixed in the contract, 50% up front.

items.title: Welding the frame
items.text: We cut the tube, weld, grind the seams and powder-coat.

items.title: The top
items.text: We glue up a solid-wood panel, sand it and apply two coats of oil.

items.title: Delivery and assembly
items.text: We deliver, assemble on site and level everything.

items.quote: We ordered furniture for the whole coffee shop. Everything arrived on time, and the chairs have not loosened in a year, even though guests rock on them.
items.author: Dilnoza

items.quote: The elm table is the heart of our flat. They made it exactly to the size of our alcove.
items.author: Timur

items.quote: They redrew the sketch three times and never rushed us. The shelving works as partitions and holds our whole archive.
items.author: Sardor

items.q: How long does a custom table take?
items.a: Usually 14 days from the deposit. Bar counters and café orders take 21 days or more; the date goes into the contract.

items.q: Can I have a different size or frame colour?
items.a: Yes. We weld to your size and paint in any RAL colour. The price is recalculated from the estimate.
Solid oak and local elm, sometimes walnut. We do not use chipboard or veneer for tops.
Yes: in Tashkent, delivery and assembly are included for orders over 5,000,000 UZS. Outside the city by arrangement.

items.q: Do you work with cafés and offices by bank transfer?
items.a: Yes, we work with companies: contract, invoice and acceptance certificate.
